releases.name: 30th Celebration: Ultra-Premium Collections (Day & Night)
releases.note: Delayed from 6 November. Toymate told pre-order customers 13 November 2026 (supplier delay in production and supply), and EB Games lists the same date. Other retailers are expected to reflect the new date, likely a supplier or distributor delay. Pre-order update, 23 September 2026: Kmart listed the Ultra-Premium Collections online, but bot traffic overwhelmed the listing and no genuine customer using a standard browser could complete a purchase. Update, 2 November 2026: Target has also now sold out its online pre-order allocation, leaving Big W as the only major retailer yet to sell the Ultra-Premium Collections online. Unconfirmed reports suggest Big W may skip an online pre-order for this product altogether, citing IT issues and ongoing bot and scalper activity, and instead push its allocation to in-store release - possibly weighted toward Queensland stores, similar to how the Focused Fighters Premium Collection played out on 30 October. Treat this as a rumour until Big W confirms one way or the other. Pokemon Center AU has not made this release available to Australian customers at all.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Ditto Premium Collection & Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.products: Ditto Premium Collection, Figure Collection (Mew & Mewtwo)
releases.note: Delayed from 6 November. Toymate told pre-order customers: "Our supplier has informed us of an unexpected delay with production and the supply of stock to Toymate. As a result, the release date has now been moved to 20-Nov-26." EB Games also lists both products for 20 November 2026. Expect other retailers to follow.

releases.name: Aura Seeker
releases.note: Reported as the next Japanese main set, releasing in Japan on 27 November 2026. Its English-language counterpart is expected to be called Flowing Fists (see below) - no Australian date yet.

releases.name: 30th Celebration: Sylveon ex Tin & Greninja ex Tin
releases.products: Sylveon ex Tin, Greninja ex Tin (4-pack version at some retailers), Mega Forces Tin (listed by EB Games)
releases.note: Some retailers sell the 5-pack version of these tins from 6 November (see Wave 4); this December date is the 4-pack version. EB Games also lists a Mega Forces Tin for 4 December. The Binder Collection was also originally slated for this wave, but Big W shipped it early in Australia alongside the Wave 1 launch on 16 September - it is not part of this December release here.

releases.name: Flowing Fists
releases.note: The expected English-language counterpart to Japan's Aura Seeker (see above), and the seventh main Mega Evolution series set, following Delta Reign. No official English or Australian release date yet - unofficial coverage points to 5 February 2027, unconfirmed by The Pokemon Company. Leaked preview imagery reportedly features Mega Lucario ex and Sigilyph ex, also unconfirmed. EB Games has typically opened pre-orders for new main sets around three months ahead of release, which would put a Flowing Fists pre-order window around early November 2026 if that pattern holds - worth watching even without a confirmed set date.
